input.quote: Client will pay TrueLink's fees for requested Hosting Services and Support Services pursuant to the schedule of charges set forth on Exhibits "A" and "B" attached hereto, (but not less than $____ per month for the Hosting Services and $____ per month for Support Services).
input.rationale: Section 5a imposes a monthly minimum fee for Hosting and Support Services, so the agreement is not at our preferred position of pure usage/ordered-services pricing. However, the commitment is confined to the current 12-month term (Section 13: one-year initial term, auto-renewing annually, terminable on 30 days' notice of non-renewal), and Section 14 gives Client a standalone right to terminate at any time, with services (and therefore fees) ending on the last day of the month following notice. There is no multi-year take-or-pay lock-in, no shortfall or penalty mechanic, and no volume cap on Client's usage. This sits at the playbook fallback and is acceptable, so no redline. Two points to note commercially rather than as deviations: the minimum dollar amounts are left blank and should be filled in (or deleted) at signature, and Section 6's carve-out barring Client from contesting or obtaining backup for the "minimum monthly fees" cross-references "Section 4" while the minimums actually appear in Section 5 — worth correcting for clarity.
